views.rationale: CAT's sales rose 22% to $50.971 bn and operating margin improved to 13.5% (up from 10.9%), while BAC's net interest income fell $426 m and net interest yield dropped 24 bps to 1.66%.
JPM investment banking revenue rose 41% and advisory fees up 85% in 2021, while GS filing only shows credit exposure without performance growth
LIN operating margin increased to 16.2% from 12.2% (4 pp) and operating profit rose 50% in 2021, whereas JNJ reported sales growth of 13.6% but no margin improvement
PFE total revenues rose 95% YoY to $81.3B, while UNH consolidated revenues grew 12% YoY
UNH earnings from operations increased 7% YoY, whereas PG operating income fell 4% and gross margin dropped 400 basis points
PG net sales grew 6% to $21.0B, while NEE operating revenues increased $105M, a far smaller absolute rise
operating income margin rose to 4.6% from 4.1% YoY, indicating improving profitability
